items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 7:10PM CST until November 15 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM; Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 kt, choppy bay waters, and Gulf seas
6 to 9 ft expected.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay, Coastal waters from High Island to
Freeport TX out 20 NM and Waters from High Island to Freeport
TX from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Saturday to 6 PM CST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds and seas may increase further as we
head into Sunday evening into Monday. A Gale Watch may be
warranted for that time frame.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
